documents.title: Howard County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 12 pages. Amounts are the Statement of Operation 'Amend Budget' (pp. 1-7). It equals 'Orig Budget' on every line except 5 lines zeroed by amendments in the 01/01/2026 period (Orig Budget is $143,774.00 higher); the Amend Budget sums match the 2026 column of the scanned Section 5 sheets (pp. 11-12) for every fund and general-fund department. column.
